title: Small-N Testing and Design Claims
description: AIL 606 textbook section connecting small-n testing and design claims to moderated usability test script with observation-to-revision trace, reader notes, support moments, and revision evidence.
learning_objectives: Analyze how the moderated usability test script with observation-to-revision trace shows a defensible decision in AIL 606.
Distinguish artifact polish from evidence-based revision.
Document a bounded AI/software support move with accepted and rejected suggestions.
Use annotations, support requests, and revision notes to decide what help or design change should come next.
